limitations: Core opportunity counts observed non-no-play scrimmage participation, not exact pass-rush or coverage snaps.
2021-2022 participation is NGS; 2023-2025 is FTN. Provider effects are retained and rates remain exposure proxies.
OLB usage cannot be reliably split into edge/off-ball; OLB_HYBRID is explicit.
PFR pressures, coverage targets, missed tackles, snaps and combine data are stored separately and excluded from default models.
Roster physical fields are archived listings, not verified yearly measurements; forecast models exclude them unless as-of validity is established.
Sacks, hits and pass breakups overlap in football value; they are modeled separately and are not added into an unvalidated total.
Default event counts are normalized PBP credits on the same valid scrimmage scope as participation; official weekly all-phase credits are preserved separately.
PBP negative_play_tackle_credits are broader than pre-2024 official TFL. Official weekly TFL is stored separately and is not spliced into the target.
Three 2025 player-seasons have uncovered event credits in participation. Their observed partial exposure is retained, but rate-model opportunity is null.
All-rostered universe includes zero-opportunity players with known GSIS IDs; unresolved roster identities are quarantined.
Anticipation/reaction/awareness are not directly measured by public box-score or participation data.
Steals are direct possession changes; blocks are disruptions and defensive rebounds end opponent possessions. They are not interchangeable and are modeled separately.
The public ESPN box score does not expose deflections, charges drawn, loose balls recovered, contested shots, matchup possessions, top speed or defensive tracking.
ESPN minutes are rounded to whole minutes. Zero-minute rows can be a sub-minute appearance or a roster-coding ambiguity; explicit flags are retained.
Historical SportsDataverse player_core files were regenerated from current ESPN profiles: reported age, experience, current team and status are not historical snapshots.
Height and weight are undated profile values. Height is treated as an adult static descriptor; weight must not be interpreted as season-specific change.
The 2026 NBA-ID crosswalk is current-season enrichment and is not comprehensive for players who left the league in earlier seasons; ESPN athlete_id remains canonical.
All-Star exhibitions and NBA Cup championship games are removed even though ESPN labels them season_type=2; only each team's 82 standings games remain.
No official NBA hustle/tracking enrichment is collected by default because the public website endpoints are undocumented and NBA reuse restrictions require separate review.
Coverage is appearance-based; zero-game roster players are absent.
MoneyPuck all-situations includes 5-on-5; the pipeline keeps the views separate.
NHL bio height/weight measurement dates are unavailable and are not annual measurements.

NHL EDGE top speed is not included: official pages expose leaderboards and per-player detail, not a supported full-roster bulk file; this baseline covers listed size and age, not current skating tests.
League-wide NHL bios do not publish wingspan, arm length, or leg length.
Public NHL data do not provide league-wide reaction time, agility, or cognitive tests.
Takeaways are scorer-recorded events and do not capture every possession recovery.
The five-season FPL common core has no tackles, interceptions, recoveries, or blocks before 2025-26.
The enhanced 2025-26 match archive publishes detailed events but no explicit open-data license.
Public events do not measure pressures, pressing attempts, forced turnovers, or possession-adjusted opportunities.
FPL role buckets do not separate center backs, fullbacks, holding midfielders, wingers, or pressing forwards.
ESPN height/weight are post-season profile snapshots and must not be interpreted as annual measurements.
Wingspan, arm length, and leg length are unavailable at league scale and remain missing.
